description: This is a shell script that automates the creation, deletion, and management of a Kubernetes 'kind' cluster. It includes functions for argument parsing, provider detection (docker or podman), prerequisite checks, and cluster lifecycle operations. The script provides user-friendly output with color coding and usage instructions.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages in blue color.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Outputs success messages in green color.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages in yellow color.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs error messages in red color and exits.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a container provider (docker or podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if the container provider responds (docker info or podman info).

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects which container engine (docker or podman) is installed and responsive.
